text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact announced an extended hiatus. 
The news stating her return date was 
undecided 
sent shockwaves across social media and 
the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
No way! Tact's going on hiatus?! For 
real?! 
Wait, this condition... 
sounds kinda familiar...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Look, Epiphaneia had this too, didn't 
she...? 
Does that mean Daring Tact might...?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
B-But it's mild, right? 
...Though her running might never be 
the same as before...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
And just when her career was really taking 
off, too...!

text_block_list.name: SNS
text_block_list.text:
"Daring Tact announces hiatus?!" 
"Return date undecided... this has gotta 
be a lie, right?" 
"I hope Daring Tact's gonna be okay..."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
...Man, it just hurts, you know? 
She gave us so much joy, and now 
we won't even get to cheer for her in 
person...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, hold on. 
Come to think of it, this time of year is—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—The Grand Fan Appreciation Festival, is 
it...?

The Spring Grand Fan Appreciation Festival 
was about to begin. 
To thank the fans who cheered them on 
daily, 
the horsegirls entertained them through 
various events.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So they can hold it this year after all. 
Last year was canceled due to the 
outbreak...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the fans 
are delighted, aren't they?

Given her injury, Tracen Academy had 
informed me 
that she was exempt from participating in 
this 
competition-heavy event if necessary.
choice_data_list: What do you want to do, Tact?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
... 
I do agree that it's best to avoid 
physical competitions.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Besides... showing up in my current state 
might only end up disappointing 
everyone.

Every fan would undoubtedly look forward 
to any chance 
to see her. And... 
it would be good for her as well.

And so, the day of the Grand Fan 
Appreciation Festival arrived— 
Though scaled down due to the outbreak, 
a huge crowd gathered. Among them...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Aha!! Hey you, you're a fan of Tact, 
aren't you! 
The voice of destiny says so!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! But I left my itabag behind...! 
How did you know?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That hairpin looks just like Tact's! 
She'll definitely be thrilled if you show 
it to her!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Tact is over this way! 
Follow me!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Brought one over!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan A
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...! I-I'm here! 
...Huh? What is this place...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, thank you for coming. 
This is Daring Tact's Portrait Sketch 
Booth.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan A
text_block_list.text:
............Whaaaaaaaaat?! 
D-D-D-Daring Tact is gonna 
draw my portrait?!

What I proposed was a portrait sketch 
booth— 
something that let Daring Tact interact 
with fans comfortably 
while playing to her artistic strengths.
choice_data_list: (I'm glad Tact agreed to do this...)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Tact's great at sketching, you see! 
Have a blast!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Epiphaneia! 
Now then, please have a seat.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
All right! 
Time to go bring over more of Tact's fans!
choice_data_list: Um, why are you helping us out?
Um, why are you helping us out?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Why? 
Isn't it obvious?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Because that girl is my destiny! 
—That alone is reason enough for me!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um, Daring Tact. 
I'm so, so sorry to hear about your 
hiatus...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(...I knew it. 
I'm letting everyone down—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—So that's why I'm gonna cheer for you 
harder than ever! 
To show how grateful I am to you, Daring 
Tact...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I'm a college student, and... 
because of the outbreak, I couldn't go to 
campus for days on end. 
It was so terribly painful.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan A
text_block_list.text:
My youth was completely stolen away from 
me... 
I could only count the things I'd never 
get back. 
...It felt like being trapped in an 
endless darkness.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan A
text_block_list.text:
But you know, your Triple Tiara victory 
showed me the way! 
It was like you told me, 'It's okay, the 
light is right here!'...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan A
text_block_list.text: —Just like a guiding flame...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan A
text_block_list.text:
So I decided I'd try my best just like 
you, and signed up for tons 
of online classes! Thanks to that... my 
life feels pretty fulfilling now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan A
text_block_list.text:
So if you're having a tough time right 
now, Tact, 
I want to cheer you on with everything 
I've got! 
So... so I'll wait for you forever!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
............ 
Thank you... so very much...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah... y-yes, right. 
Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa, this is insanely detailed...!! 
Even the bone structure...! 
...Thank you so much, I'll treasure it!

As the afternoon came and we moved 
locations to continue 
the event... visitor after visitor took 
the opportunity 
to express their heartfelt gratitude to 
her.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Seriously, it got me so hyped! 
You were so magnificent in the Japan Cup, 
showing such strength against Almond Eye!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Giving us that kind of passion during 
times like that... 
Seriously, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, not at all...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks to you, Daring Tact, 
I finally felt excited about the future 
again!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I truly believe now that we'll all be able 
to cheer together again. 
So when that time comes... 
I'll deliver my gratitude with the biggest 
cheers ever!

And then, the Fan Appreciation Festival 
was drawing to a close. 
The woman Epiphaneia brought over 
was the very last person we had time for.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan B
text_block_list.text:
...Um, about the sketch... 
Instead of drawing me, 
would a self-portrait of Daring Tact 
herself be okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah! 
And if possible, together with the 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I just really love the vibe between the 
two of you... 
Is that no good, after all?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...No, let us try. 
Tore-san, please come over here.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...All right.

Being fixed with Daring Tact's sharp gaze 
made my heart skip a beat. 
Is this what it feels like to be a frog 
mesmerized by a snake...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...It is done. 
Next is myself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—It is finished. 
How... does this look?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan B
text_block_list.text: Th-this is...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer's eyes look terrifying!! 
The level of detail is insane...!
choice_data_list:
There's so much intensity in those eyes... 
Why...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
D-do you think so? 
I am sorry...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You were gazing so intently at me the 
entire time I was sketching, 
so perhaps your eyes left a particularly 
strong impression...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan B
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I'm so happy! 
I'll cherish it forever!

All things considered, the Fan 
Appreciation Festival 
wrapped up without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan B
text_block_list.text:
A-a-amazing...! 
My two faves look so hyper-realistic... in 
the flesh...!
choice_data_list:
(I almost feel like I was drawn a little 
too well...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Still, what made you choose a composition 
where Daring Tact is running 
and the Trainer is watching over her?

Indeed, Daring Tact had spent the day 
capturing what was right before her eyes 
with pinpoint precision. 
This piece was, in a sense, an imaginary 
scene.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To capture the sensation of my running, 
I once sketched scenes from my own 
training footage.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So I knew I could draw that right away for 
a self-portrait... 
and besides...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I am running, I always want... 
Tore-san to be watching over me.
choice_data_list:
Daring Tact... Of course I'll always be 
watching!

Daring Tact... Of course I'll always be 
watching!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what is with these two... 
I ship them so hard...!

And so, the Fan Appreciation Festival 
concluded successfully. 
The sketch Daring Tact drew was shared on 
social media, 
quickly becoming quite the hot topic.
